  {"step":1,"file":"description.txt","function":"<global>","line":1,"var":"vulnerability description","code":"OSS-Fuzz issue 42521166 (hdf5): Heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 found by fuzz target h5_extended_fuzzer [asan]","note":"The bug is in HDF5 and is reached by the extended fuzzer input path."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/../h5_extended_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":14,"var":"data,size","code":"fwrite(data, size, 1, fp);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are written verbatim into a temporary HDF5 file."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/../h5_extended_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"filename","code":"H5Fopen(filename, H5F_ACC_RDWR, H5P_DEFAULT);","note":"The crafted file is reopened by HDF5 for parsing and object traversal."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/test/links.c","function":"build_visit_file","line":15593,"var":"file layout","code":"Create groups, datasets, named datatypes, soft links, hard links, and external links for visiting tests.","note":"The vulnerable path depends on object-graph traversal over a file containing mixed link/object types."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/test/links.c","function":"obj_visit_by_name","line":16040,"var":"H5Ovisit_by_name3(...)","code":"H5Ovisit_by_name3(fid, \"/\", H5_INDEX_NAME, H5_ITER_INC, visit_obj_cb, &udata, H5O_INFO_BASIC, H5P_DEFAULT)","note":"Object visitation recursively walks reachable objects starting from the supplied location."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/test/links.c","function":"visit_obj_cb","line":15913,"var":"name, oinfo","code":"if (HDstrcmp(op_data->info[op_data->idx].path, name) != 0) return (H5_ITER_ERROR);","note":"The callback consumes object names and metadata produced by the traversal."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5Oint.c","function":"H5O__get_info","line":2202,"var":"oinfo->type / oinfo->rc","code":"if (fields & H5O_INFO_BASIC) { ... oinfo->type = obj_class->type; oinfo->rc = oh->nlink; }","note":"The library fills the object-info structure from the protected object header before invoking the callback."},
  {"step":8,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5Odeprec.c","function":"H5O__iterate1_adapter","line":137,"var":"oinfo2->token","code":"if (shim_data->fields & H5O_INFO_BASIC) { ... if (H5VLnative_token_to_addr(obj_id, oinfo2->token, &oinfo.addr) < 0) ... }","note":"Legacy object-visit adapters deserialize object tokens and copy native info, propagating traversal state into callback-visible data."},
  {"step":9,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5O.c","function":"H5Ovisit_by_name3","line":1872,"var":"loc_params.loc_data.loc_by_name.name","code":"loc_params.type = H5VL_OBJECT_BY_NAME; loc_params.loc_data.loc_by_name.name = obj_name; ... H5VL_object_specific(... H5VL_OBJECT_VISIT ...)","note":"The by-name visit API passes the attacker-influenced object path into the VOL traversal machinery."},
  {"step":10,"file":"src-vul/hdf5/src/H5VLnative_object.c","function":"H5VL__native_object_specific","line":389,"var":"visit recursion","code":"H5Ovisit/H5Ovisit_by_name","note":"Native VOL object visitation recurses through the object graph and reaches the buggy sink in the HDF5 object-info path."}
]
